summary: Retest of /orders layout after iteration_6 fixes. Ran Playwright at 390 and 1920 in both signed-out and signed-in (aarohi@cleliastudio-demo.com) states. All 5 acceptance criteria PASS. Signed-out empty state now renders exactly ONE .orders-empty section (0 duplicate orders-error-message elements), with the 96px champagne circle (getComputedStyle: 96x96, borderRadius 50%, bg rgba(196,178,161,0.22)) wrapping a 48x48 Package SVG and heading 'Your story starts here.'. Populated cards now show short friendly heading (e.g. 'Bespoke piece 51086C4E' - no raw UUID), status eyebrow (QC/In Production/New), 'Due 2026-07-29' date, amount ('₹2,76,000'), and a 'View details' link with href '/orders/<id>'. Overflow (scrollWidth - clientWidth) = 0 at both 390 and 1920. Sticky 60px header with account menu (My Designs / My Orders / Profile & Address / Staff Login / Sign Out) still works. No JS page errors; only 3 unrelated network 401s (background fetch, not blocking).

issues: Inside each .customer-order-card the two inner <div>s (info column + amount/view-details column) sit side-by-side even on the 390px viewport, causing the amount '₹2,76,000' to overlap on top of the wrapped 'Bespoke piece 51086C4E' heading. Consider stacking the two columns vertically (flex-direction: column) below ~500px so amount + View details sit under the info block.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: stack customer-order-card inner columns vertically at <=480px to avoid amount overlapping the heading on mobile (see design_issues).
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerOrdersPage.jsx: no AbortController cleanup for the /api/orders fetch on unmount (state update on unmounted component still possible).
startPayment shows 'Your secure payment window is ready to open.' but never opens any window - misleading UX.
CustomerAppHeader.jsx: account menu still has no outside-click / Escape close handler (unchanged from iteration_6).
CustomerAppHeader.jsx: avatar circle still shows hard-coded 'C' rather than deriving initial from the signed-in user's name.

success_rate.frontend: 5/5 acceptance criteria PASS. Only remaining item is an optional mobile-column-stack polish.

Verified DOM values: emptyCount=1, errorMsgCount=0, iconWrap=96x96 radius 50%, svg=48x48, headings short (Bespoke piece <8-char>), date + amount + View details present, overflow=0 at 390 and 1920. Only remaining nit is 390px column overlap inside customer-order-card.
